articles.title: VHP Bans 'Muslims’ From Garba Celebrations or Events | Aadhaar, Tilak Checks in Maharashtra | News
articles.description: A fresh controversy has erupted in Maharashtra ahead of Navratri after the Vishva Hindu Parishad (VHP) announced that Muslims should not be allowed to participate in Garba and Dandiya events across the state.The VHP has also issued guidelines for event organisers, including checking attendees’ Aadhaar cards and applying tilak on their foreheads to verify what it describes as the Hindu identity of participants. The guidelines come ahead of Navratri, which begins on October 11 this year.VHP spokesperson and joint secretary Shriraj Nair defended the move, saying Navratri is a religious festival centred on worship of the Goddess and that the organisation wants to protect the cultural character of Hindu festivals. The VHP has described the measures as precautionary, while critics have raised questions over religious discrimination, identity checks and access to public cultural events.The controversy is also significant because it comes shortly after RSS chief Mohan Bhagwat spoke about universal oneness and the dignity of all people during his New York address. The VHP has declined to comment on Bhagwat’s remarks.Is this about preserving the religious character of Navratri — or does it cross the line into religious exclusion?Watch this LIVE coverage for the latest political reactions, the VHP’s guidelines and the growing Maharashtra Garba-Dandiya row. -news CNN-News18 is your trusted source for breaking news, updates, and in-depth analysis from around the world. articles.title: In 1951, two female stray dogs named Dezik and Tsygan became the first mammals to successfully cross the border of space and return alive
articles.description: In 1951, two female stray dogs named Dezik and Tsygan became the first mammals to successfully cross the border of space and return alive. The data later supported Soviet research into animal and human spaceflight.
